import hashlib, os, subprocess, sys, tempfile, urllib.request
sources = (
    ("sweep.py", "PR_UPKEEP_SWEEP_SOURCE_URL", "PR_UPKEEP_SWEEP_SOURCE_SHA256"),
    ("pr_upkeep_jira.py", "PR_UPKEEP_SWEEP_JIRA_SOURCE_URL", "PR_UPKEEP_SWEEP_JIRA_SOURCE_SHA256"),
    ("pr_upkeep_emit.py", "PR_UPKEEP_SWEEP_EMIT_SOURCE_URL", "PR_UPKEEP_SWEEP_EMIT_SOURCE_SHA256"),
    ("pr_upkeep_github.py", "PR_UPKEEP_SWEEP_GITHUB_SOURCE_URL", "PR_UPKEEP_SWEEP_GITHUB_SOURCE_SHA256"),
)
directory = tempfile.mkdtemp()
for filename, url_ref, digest_ref in sources:
    body = urllib.request.urlopen(os.environ[url_ref], timeout=60).read()
    if hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest() != os.environ[digest_ref]:
        sys.exit(f"sweep-cycle: fetched {{filename} bytes do not match the granted digest; refusing to run unverified code")
    open(os.path.join(directory, filename), "wb").write(body)
path = os.path.join(directory, "sweep.py")
code = subprocess.run([sys.executable, path]).returncode
# 0 = emitted, 10 = empty sweep: both are successful emitter
# passes (the facts, or the absence of new facts, are appended /
# not needed). Anything else is a technical failure.
sys.exit(0 if code in (0, 10) else code)
